experimental_design: For stable isotope labeling, Hela cells were cultured in DMEM medium for SILAC (Thermo fisher, cat # 88364) supplemented with 10% dialyzed FBS (Sigma, F0392) and stable isotope labeled lysine and arginine (light: 12 C and 14 N; heavy: 13 C and 15 N; 50 mg each for 500 mL medium).
number_of_biological_replicates: At least three biological replicates were performed for each condition.
number_of_technical_replicates: Generally, 50 thousand cells in 100 uL were seeded in triplicate in a black, clear bottom 96-well plate for each condition tested.
technology_type: Liquid chromatography and tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS)
